svg.title: PiLink — SSH and Internet over BLE
svg.desc: One BLE L2CAP CoC connects a Raspberry Pi to either an Android phone or a Mac. The client's SSH app connects to the Pi's OpenSSH server, while the Pi's TCP apps use tun0 to reach the Internet through the client's Wi-Fi or cellular connection. A shared Wi-Fi network is not required. The phone illustrates the app's dark connection screen, with its Japanese labels translated into English for this diagram.
svg.text: SSH into your Pi. Share your phone or Mac's Internet over BLE.
Android robot: Google · CC BY 3.0. Raspberry Pi and Apple marks identify the supported platforms.
